title: Quantum unique ergodicity
exact_target: On every compact negatively curved manifold without boundary, must the probability density of every sequence of normalized high-energy Laplace eigenfunctions become uniformly distributed over the manifold?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 4900014 (AMR-048-0014). CC BY 4.0.
Nalini Anantharaman and Stéphane Nonnenmacher, Half-delocalization of Eigenfunctions for the Laplacian on an Anosov Manifold (2007), introduction, p. 1, and section 1, pp. 3--5.
